meaning: H-dev: 400 self-play games of the research champion c5 (docs/h7-rl-plan.md 9.11, 9.12), generated now, before any R2 result; for R2 diagnosis and R3 development and selection only; never gradient training data; never promotion, final confirmation or independent generalisation evidence

holdout_notes.seed: reserved H7-R seed 8787 (hybrid.h6_labels.RESERVED_SEEDS): the run seed of h7c_selfplay --holdout-contract; not an opening-suite generation seed
holdout_notes.cycle: the cycle number of the derived game / opening seeds and game ids (h7c:c1:8787:i); checked collision-free for 400 games; it names no H7-c training cycle
holdout_notes.generation: now, before R2 results are seen; only through h7c_selfplay --holdout-contract and h7r_holdout labels (never the training label or cache paths)
holdout_notes.stats: the stats block is the contract format's Arena setting (opening-pair bootstrap); it is not the H-dev reading rule. R2 reads H-dev with a source-game bootstrap fixed in the R2 contract

access.allowed: R2 / R3 may read the H-dev games, labels and metrics repeatedly for diagnosis, development and checkpoint / recipe selection
forbidden: gradient training, replay or distillation targets, or any training cache
promotion, final confirmation or independent generalisation evidence
access.separate: H-conf and A-conf are other data under other contracts; this contract neither makes nor uses them
access.consequence: once H-dev has guided a choice, it cannot be independent evidence for that choice
